attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable), node2, and node3 (standbys, read-only) on AlmaLinux 9.6. Installed postgresql-server 16.14 via the AppStream module on all nodes, initdb'd node1, created a scram-sha-256 replicator role, enabled wal_level=replica/max_wal_senders/hot_standby, opened firewalld port 5432 for the cluster subnet, and cloned node2/node3 from node1 via pg_basebackup -R with dedicated replication slots (node2_slot, node3_slot). Verified a row inserted on the primary replicated to both standbys and that standbys reject writes as read-only. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot-ID baselines and healthy replication state on all three nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time (preserving quorum), proved each node's boot_id changed post-restart, and confirmed full recovery — postgresql active, correct recovery role, replication slots/walreceivers reconnected, and existing data intact — after each restart, finishing with a fresh post-restart write on the primary that replicated to both standbys.
